newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's '97 stock index to open at 641.89 points.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's '97 stock index to open at 641.89 points.

text.p: The Korea Stock Price Index (KOSPI), South Korea's composite stock index, will open at 641.89 on January 3, down 9.33 points from the 1996 closing of 651.22, the Korea Herald quoted the Korea Stock Exchange as saying.
The index was revised downward after taking into account companies that balance their books in December, and firms that have gone ex-dividend as of December 31, the English-language paper reported..
An ex-dividend is the interval period between the announcement and the payment of the next dividend. An investor who buys shares during the interval is not entitled to the dividend, the paper said.
Usually, a stock price rises as the ex-dividend date approaches and then falls after that date.
The composite stock index for 1996 closed on Friday at the year's lowest level, down 26.24 percent from the year's opening of 882.94.
